reference.matched_quantity: Fig. 2(d) finite photonic-crystal square side L = 300 micrometres
reference.note: This is the finite cavity size, not the 400 micrometre time-domain numerical window used by the earlier reproduction.

motifs.square: Central main hole at the origin plus one satellite near a cell diagonal; nonzero areas, independently varied size, shape and orientation; periodic images included in gap checks.
motifs.triangular: Central main hole plus one satellite in each of two diagonal primitive directions, nominally -30 and +30 degrees; distances, offsets, area shares, shapes and orientations varied; central main hole no smaller in area than either satellite.

semiconductor.layers: Current complete Inoue Table-I stack, including PC190/GaAs110/spacer25 nm and three 10 nm wells plus three 20 nm barriers, with common claddings.
semiconductor.period: Initial screens tune the frozen Bragg reference to 950 nm. Final designs tune the physical period so that the actual lowest frequency-closed pole lies within 0.05 nm of 950 nm, then fix that period while closing competing poles. Both reference and actual wavelengths must be reported.
semiconductor.threshold_definition: g_th = (2 alpha_field + alpha_internal_intensity)/(Gamma_active n_active/n_eff); add the material intensity loss once.
semiconductor.comparison: Same footprint, nominal wavelength, materials and vertical layer thicknesses. Different optimized motifs and filling fractions remain design variables.

YbYAG.material_status: Nominal cross sections and material data, not measured spectroscopy.
YbYAG.comparison: Use the same vertical stack, gain model, pump definition and footprint for both lattices. Tune the final actual first frequency-closed pole to 1030 +/- 0.05 nm and then fix the period for its competitors. Report total internal first-entry pump power, with shared inversion and reabsorption. Top single-pass is a common pump-architecture comparison; ideal narrow-edge pumping is conditional.
YbYAG.implementation: True four-wave square and six-wave triangular CWT with the same layered outgoing Green-function and flux convention.

beam.quantity: Actual eigenmode complex vector far field, intensity |Ex|^2+|Ey|^2
additional_checks: one half-maximum connected component including the normal
side lobes and encircled energy within the evaluated window

mode_selection.relative_gain_gap: g_second/g_first - 1, using actual independently found finite transverse modes rather than just Gamma-family representatives.
mode_selection.gap_interpretation: Semiconductor material-gain gaps are distinct from current gaps under the nonlinear gain law. YAG zero-photon shared-inversion branch-crossing gaps are distinct from saturated higher-mode turn-on powers; use the separate CW competition results for the latter.
mode_selection.selection: Keep a Pareto set for low first threshold, isolation and circular bright-center output. Report failure when no candidate meets every target.
validation: coarse complete discrete spectrum where tractable
mode_selection.scope: Best tested candidates within stated search ranges, not a certified global optimum, exhaustive continuum spectrum or proof of dynamic single-mode lasing.

fabrication_assumption.status: Common research design rules only; not a foundry certification. Exploratory cases using weaker rules must be labeled separately.

polarization.convention: S3 = +2 Im(Ex Ey*), with no right/left handedness label
polarization.scope: Circular intensity and circular polarization are distinct. Angularly integrated polarization describes spatial mixing, not temporal depolarization.

storage: Scanning stages retain compact parameter/metric CSV and JSON. Preserve final complex fields, portable configurations and compact failed-counterexample evidence. No presentation assets belong in PCSELSim.

outcome_notes.semiconductor: Both primary candidates meet preferred nominal bright/circular beam and >=10% tested cold material-gain gap; current gaps remain below 1%.
outcome_notes.YbYAG_square: Nominal beam meets preferred targets, but 3.589% tested cold-gain gap fails preferred 10% isolation; static CW is already multimode at sampled 1.25x threshold.
outcome_notes.YbYAG_triangular: Selected bright-round v5 meets nominal preferred beam and 11.961% tested cold-gain gap. Static CW single first mode at sampled 1.05/1.25/1.5x, two at 2/3/4x. Isolation and radial-L2 alternatives retained.
outcome_notes.scope: Bounded searches, finite mode sets and nominal material model. Fabrication robustness and dynamic single-mode stability are not established.
